title: Electric Motor
guideIdle: Low current — the coil turns slowly in the magnetic field.
guideSpinning: Raise current — torque increases and RPM climbs.
guideStrong: Strong current — maximum spin. Speed is proportional to current.
conditionsHint: A current-carrying coil in a magnetic field feels a torque — that spins the motor.
learnMore: Magnets provide a field; current in the coil creates forces that produce continuous rotation.
